<h2>Resolve the sjSDM Fitting Device</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Internal helper that validates GPU runtime requirements and resolves the
CPU-parallelism setting for the selected fitting device.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>.resolve_sjsdm_device(
  device = c("cpu", "gpu"),
  parallel = 0L,
  gpu_runtime_validator = validate_sjsdm_gpu_runtime
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="device">device</code></td>
<td>
<p>Selected sjSDM device.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="parallel">parallel</code></td>
<td>
<p>Requested CPU parallelism.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="gpu_runtime_validator">gpu_runtime_validator</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable strict GPU runtime validator.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing 'device' and 'parallel'.
</p>

</main>
